description: This file defines the OperatingSystem class within the SuiteCRM Utility namespace, which provides methods for detecting the operating system type and converting file paths to match the OS conventions.

classes.name: OperatingSystem
classes.description: A utility class for detecting the current operating system and converting file paths accordingly.

methods.name: isOsBSD
methods.description: Checks if the current operating system is BSD based.

methods.name: isOsLinux
methods.description: Checks if the current operating system is Linux.

methods.name: isOsMacOSX
methods.description: Checks if the current operating system is Mac OS X (Darwin).

methods.name: isOsSolaris
methods.description: Checks if the current operating system is Solaris.

methods.name: isOsUnknown
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is reported as Unknown.

methods.name: isOsWindows
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is Windows.

methods.name: toOsPath
methods.description: Converts a given path string to the style of the current operating system, optionally replacing separators.
